Class PoolChatServer.Child

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.pool.PoolChatServer.Child
Enclosing class:
PoolChatServer
private static final class PoolChatServer.Child extends Object
The Child class is one ACP seat for one user. It holds the link, the session id, the hold text, and the prompt sink. A blank host keeps a grok agent stdio process. A set host keeps a WebSocket to grok agent serve.
